column2: The Great Bastion Besieged

The hordes of the Northern Wastes have come south in numbers not seen in an age, and hurl themselves against the Great Bastion. Every soldier the Dragon Throne can spare is on the wall, the Silk Road is all but closed, and the sky over the north burns with the light of the Ruinous Powers.

Ogre Raids

Ogre tribes have come down out of the Mountains of Mourning to eat their way through the western provinces of Cathay. The garrisons of the frontier are fighting them valley by valley, and the caravans of the Silk Road travel at their peril.
§Y*§! The value of the Silk Road is reduced by §R50%§!\n§Y*§! Cathay might buy the Ogres off, and some of that silver will find its way to the Ogre Kingdoms
War Beneath the Earth

Clan Eshin and the other clans of the Under-Empire are gnawing at Cathay from below. Wells turn foul, officials die in their beds, and whole storehouses of jade vanish overnight down holes that were not there the day before.

Assault the Dragon Throne

Beyond the eastern edge of the world lies Grand Cathay, ruled by a dragon who thinks himself eternal. The Dark Gods say otherwise. March on the Great Bastion and put a champion of the Ruinous Powers on the Dragon Throne.
An adult, unlanded member of your dynasty at court will lead the claim. If there is none, a champion of your dynasty will step forward. If the war is won, §Ythe claimant becomes Emperor of Cathay§!.
Launch an Expedition into Cathay

Grand Cathay is the richest empire in the world, and its riches lie just beyond the eastern edge of the map. You have no wish to sit on the Dragon Throne, but there is gold, slaves, influence and learning to be had there for anyone strong enough to take it.
You will choose what the expedition is after: §Yplunder§!, §Yslaves§!, §Yinfluence§! or §Yknowledge§!.
If the war is won: §G+4000§! gold, prestige, and a Cathayan jian or dragon amulet. Cathay will not forget.
If the war is won: §G+1500§! gold, and Cathayan slaves put to work in up to four of your provinces for 20 years. Cathay will not forget.
If the war is won: §G+2500§! Grace, favoured trade with Cathay for 50 years, the Jade Dragon, and Cathay is forced to open its borders.
If the war is won: faster technology spread for 50 years, a Cathayan water clock, and two Cathayan scholars join your court.
